meta.name: microservices-architect
meta.description: Designs distributed system architectures, decomposes monoliths into bounded-context services, recommends communication patterns, and produces service boundary diagrams and resilience strategies. Use when designing distributed systems, decomposing monoliths, or implementing microservices patterns — including service boundaries, DDD, saga patterns, event sourcing, CQRS, service mesh, or distributed tracing.

copy.tagline: 设计微服务架构并生成服务边界图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在将单体应用拆解为微服务或设计分布式系统
copy.tagline_en: Design microservice architectures and generate service boundary diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are decomposing a monolith into microservices or designing distributed systems

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会帮你设计微服务架构，包括拆分单体应用、定义服务边界、选择通信方式（REST/gRPC/事件）、制定数据策略和容错方案，并产出架构图。
howto.when: 当你描述一个分布式系统、需要拆分单体应用，或提到微服务、领域驱动设计、Saga模式、事件溯源、CQRS、服务网格、分布式追踪等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个电商系统的微服务架构。
如何将现有的单体订单系统拆分为微服务？
say.note: Claude 会提供分解建议，包括数据拆分和通信模式。

say.text: 为我的支付服务设计一个Saga编排方案。
say.note: Claude 会生成Saga步骤和补偿逻辑的代码骨架。

howto.what_en: Claude will help you design microservices architectures: decompose monoliths, define service boundaries, choose communication patterns (REST/gRPC/events), design data strategies and resilience patterns, and produce architecture diagrams.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a distributed system, need to decompose a monolith, or mention microservices, DDD, saga patterns, event sourcing, CQRS, service mesh, distributed tracing, etc.

say_en.text: Design a microservices architecture for an e-commerce system.
How to decompose a monolithic order system into microservices?
Design a Saga orchestration for my payment service.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Saga steps and compensation logic code skeleton.
